name: Valle de la Luna
science: Curiosity's 44th drill hole, in the Monte Grande hollow: is the hollow rock different from the ridges?
risk: Floor of a hollow, 2 m below the ridge next to it; edges up to 18° slope.
scienceSource: NASA Curiosity blog, sols 4695-4701 (13 Nov 2025): drill hole 44 inside the Monte Grande hollow

name: Nevado Sajama
science: Drilled on a boxwork ridge top, 10 m from Valle de la Luna: ridge rock versus hollow rock.
risk: Ridge top, 2 m above the hollow; slopes up to 18° on the way up.
scienceSource: NASA Curiosity blog, sols 4716-4722 (18 Nov 2025): drilled on top of a ridge, Navcam sol 4718
taskSource: Task times proposed from NASA/TP-2017-219457, table 30
nameOrigin: NASA named the target after an extinct volcano, the highest peak in Bolivia
